claim: Try a ready sample project without saving to real project data
where: landing first action, app demo banner, README
sandbox: preseed real storage, open /demo/, edit and reset, assert the real keys are unchanged

claim: Audio processing stays on this device
where: landing facts, app footer, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; exercise cleanup and assert every request remains same-origin

claim: The installed app works offline
sandbox: load /demo/ as the installed shell, set the browser context offline, and export without a request

claim: Rights confirmation gates export; the pack includes labeled PCM WAV excerpts, a manifest, and an edit receipt without changing the source
where: landing pack contents and method, app export, terms, README
sandbox: export the clean sample and inspect ZIP filenames, receipt, and originalModified manifest value

claim: Changing a recording or score clears its old timing and requires fresh rights confirmation
where: app source replacement status and export gate
sandbox: confirm rights in the sample, replace its audio with a one-second WAV and its score with a new map, then inspect the respaced non-silent export and renewed gate

claim: MusicXML rehearsal marks become editable timing suggestions
where: landing method, app source step, README
sandbox: open /demo/ and assert its three named score suggestions and editable time fields

claim: MusicXML score marks become suggestions and PDF score references stay attached
where: landing method, app source step, README
sandbox: clean workbench; import MusicXML and PDF fixtures; assert suggestions and the PDF reference control

claim: Imports PCM WAV recordings
where: landing method, app source step, README
sandbox: clean workbench; import a generated PCM WAV and assert decoded source details

claim: Mark passages with a pointer, arrow keys, or exact time fields
sandbox: clean demo; drag the waveform, use ArrowRight, then add a named exact-time passage

claim: Preview the source or cleaned copy before export
sandbox: clean demo; activate both preview controls and assert the transport updates

claim: Exported cleanup changes the signal for rumble, presence, dynamics, hum, and hiss
where: landing scope, app cleanup controls, README
sandbox: import a generated multitone WAV; export every preset and hum mode; measure the resulting WAV frequency magnitudes and quiet-to-loud dynamics

claim: No account is required for import, cleanup, or export
sandbox: fresh anonymous /demo/ context; enable export without identity or license input

claim: Core tools are free; a $39 one-time Steward license adds notes and named sign-off
where: landing pricing, app license panel, README
sandbox: assert free demo controls, locked optional fields, exact price, features, and Sociobot checkout URL

claim: A hosted checkout return stores, removes, and verifies the Steward license before desktop handoff
sandbox: open the landing page with a fixture license query, stub the Sociobot verdict, and assert storage, URL removal, verification, and desktop handoff controls

claim: Desktop downloads are provided for macOS, Windows, and Linux
sandbox: stub a four-platform GitHub release response and assert each platform resolves to its asset

claim: Releases include SHA256 checksums, and terminal installers reject a mismatched download
sandbox: generate release metadata from four fixture artifacts; compare every digest; run the Unix installer against matching and mismatched local fixtures; enforce the PowerShell checksum guard

claim: A recent Steward verdict is reused and license verification runs at most once per day
sandbox: preseed a current verified verdict, open the real app, assert Steward access and no verification request

claim: License verification sends the license token to the license service
sandbox: forced clean verification; intercept the request and assert its URL contains only the token parameter

claim: Current desktop builds are unsigned
sandbox: inspect workflow signing configuration and the published install warning

claim: There are no controls for voice cloning, missing-sound reconstruction, or SATB isolation
where: landing scope section, app cleanup scope
sandbox: inspect shipped source dependencies and controls for only documented local filters

claim: The website loads no third-party scripts, fonts, trackers, or advertising
sandbox: fresh landing load with release API stub; inspect requests and loaded script, style, and font resources
